sections.summary: Dijkstra argues that the dynamic process, not just the static program, is the true subject matter of programming. He develops textual and dynamic indices to describe process progress and concludes that the unrestricted go to statement destroys any helpful coordinate system for that progress. He therefore recommends abolishing it from higher-level languages and says proposed clauses should preserve a programmer-independent coordinate system.
sections.title: Go To Statement Considered Harmful
